reason: The text demonstrates agency among non-leaders. The Israelite people (עַם) scatter throughout Egypt to gather straw independently (וַיָּ֥פֶץ הָעָ֖ם בְּכָל־ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם לְקֹשֵׁ֥שׁ קַ֖שׁ). Additionally, individual Egyptian servants exercise agency: those who fear God's word make the decision to move their servants and livestock to safety (הַיָּרֵא֙ אֶת־ דְּבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה... הֵנִ֛יס אֶת־ עֲבָדָ֥יו וְאֶת־ מִקְנֵ֖הוּ אֶל־ הַבָּתִּֽים), while others who do not heed God's word make the opposite choice, leaving their livestock in the field. These actions show that ordinary people, not merely leaders, make consequential decisions and take purposeful action throughout the narrative.
